import unreal,json
from pathlib import Path
e=unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.EditorActorSubsystem)
u=unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.UnrealEditorSubsystem)
l=unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.LevelEditorSubsystem)
world=u.get_editor_world()
if '/Game/Environment/Mall/Maps/Lvl_MallAtrium_Test.' not in world.get_path_name():
    raise RuntimeError('Expected separate mall test map')
changes=[]
for a in e.get_all_level_actors():
    if a.get_actor_label() in ['VerticalAccess_Stairs_01','VerticalAccess_Stairs_02']:
        old=a.get_actor_location();a.modify();a.set_actor_location(unreal.Vector(old.x,old.y,6.0),False,False)
        changes.append({'actor':a.get_actor_label(),'old_z':old.z,'new_z':a.get_actor_location().z})
saved=l.save_current_level()
root=Path(unreal.Paths.project_dir()).resolve()
(root/'Saved/MallBuild/landing_correction.json').write_text(json.dumps({'changes':changes,'saved':saved},indent=2))
unreal.log(json.dumps({'changes':changes,'saved':saved}))
